thread.title: Apple, chipmaker stocks fall after TSMC delivers weaker-than-expected outlook

title: Apple, chipmaker stocks fall after TSMC delivers weaker-than-expected outlook

organizations.name: emily bary  shares of apple inc

text:
10:02 a.m. ET Share 
By Emily Bary 
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.83% and several chipmakers are down in Thursday morning trading after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. TSM, -5.70% delivered a June-quarter outlook that came up short of expectations. Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini wrote Thursday that he and his team were "lowering our estimates for TSM to account for a steeper than expected inventory digestion by premium Smart Phone customers, particularly Apple." Apple's stock is down 1.9%, while Intel's stock is off 2.3%. Other chipmakers have seen their shares hit as well, including Nvidia Corp. NVDA, -3.10% Qualcomm Inc. QCOM, -4.82% Broadcom Ltd. AVGO, -2.70% and Applied Materials Inc. AMAT, -6.47% The PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, -4.31% is off 2.8%, while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.57% is down 0.5%. Quote References
